text:
elaine: :mega: Planned maintenance - az-east1 NIC microcode roll + minor kernel out-of-tree patch. Goal: remove intermittent p99 jitter seen on long prompt chains. Window: 2026-07-18 22:30 UTC -> 02:30 UTC (4h). We'll run a staggered, low-impact cascade across 6 cohorts. Details follow.
omar: how big are cohorts and expected per-cohort time?
elaine: cohorts are intentionally small: 6 cohorts x ~9 racks (~6-8% region capacity each). Per cohort ~15-25m (cordon -> graceful drain -> reboot -> kvcache seed -> smoke probe). Full window includes buffer for slow drains and manual verification.
natalie: private/dedicated pools? will any customers be affected?
elaine: Dedicated pools tagged `dedicated-east` are set to opt-out. If backfill can't maintain headroom, we'll temporarily place jobs on pre-warmed us-west burst nodes (transparent to tenants). We'll send targeted alerts to top-20 QPS tenants.
ben-oncall: I'll be oncall and watching latency/error dashboards 22:15-02:45 UTC. Escalate if p95 > 220ms or error-rate increase > 0.5% sustained for 90s. Also notify me on any `OOMKilled` pod spikes.
ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: https://status.redwood/maintenance/az-east1-1825004321 (window 22:30-02:30 UTC).
elaine: runbook snippet: preheat 10m before cohort start; cordon with graceful timeout 240s; drain with `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=240`; reboot nodes; after node ready run `kvcache-prime --region az-east1 --cohort $COHORT --shards 10 --concurrency 6`; then run golden probe. If probe passes (p95 < 160ms and health OK) -> uncordon.
omar: example commands?
elaine:
```
# cordon
kubectl cordon node-az-east1-xyz
# drain
kubectl drain node-az-east1-xyz --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=240 --timeout=15m
# after reboot
ssh ops@bastion "kvcache-prime --region az-east1 --cohort $COHORT --shards 10 --concurrency 6"
# golden probe
curl -fsS https://ops.redwood/health/az-east1/cohort/$COHORT | jq .status
```
natalie: rollback plan? if we see regressions mid-window do we keep cohort cordoned or failover?
elaine: rollback policy: stop further cohorts immediately. For the affected cohort, keep cordoned and route tenant traffic to eu-central pre-warmed fallback. Automatic failover triggers after 90s of failing healthchecks for the cohort. If fallback doesn't stabilize in 5m, escalate to @infra-lead for potential reimage or microcode rollback.
ben-oncall: add thresholds to pager duty run: p95 > 220ms OR error-rate delta > 0.5% OR request drop > 0.25%. I'll run the first cohort with elaine.
ops-bot: Observability: enabled high-res traces and increased metric scrape rate for az-east1 from 22:10-03:00 UTC.
elainE: cost note: cross-region fallback to us-west will incur egress and on-demand GPU cost. Finance estimate (worst-case full fallback for 6 cohorts) ~= $3.8k. Charge code: infra-maint-2026.
omar: can we pre-seed kvcache for the whole region to reduce warmup after each reboot?
elaine: we will pre-seed only the immediate upcoming cohort 10m prior to reduce background load. Full-region seed is too risky. We'll run a low-QPS mirrored smoke traffic against new nodes right after uncordon.
ben-oncall: ensure we have a golden-traffic job targeting heavy prompt patterns (long seq > 2k tokens). If p99 shows regressions, abort.
natalie: I'll draft the customer-facing banner and short email for the top tenants.
infra-lead: please also add a short note in #support and attach the runbook link. I'll join if we need a manual rollback.
elaine: thanks all. I'll post the full playbook and escalation matrix to /runbooks/az-east1-nic-microcode-cascade.md and pin it here. See you in the window :rocket:
